claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Nebius 之後的 6-K（季度財報附註、股東信）或年度 20-F 寫出 Capacity Agreement 終止、縮減（保證容量低於約 250 MW 或費用上限下修）、條件未滿足而未 commence，或寫出改用燃氣渦輪／往復式引擎或電網取代燃料電池。核查頻率：每季（Nebius 6-K）與每年（20-F）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊的 confidence，重讀 tech:sofc_onsite_power 需求側（與 Oracle 那條一併看）。
claims.statement: Buyer-side filing (Nebius Group N.V. Q1 2026 interim financial statements, note 16 subsequent events): on May 14, 2026 a Nebius subsidiary signed a Master Fuel Cell Capacity Agreement and related system orders with Bloom Energy Corporation; Nebius buys the capacity and electricity, Bloom installs, operates and maintains the systems; three phases of 10-year supply terms, guaranteed capacity of approximately 250 MW (installed approximately 328 MW); monthly service fees of up to $2.6 billion in aggregate, subject to commencement upon satisfaction of certain conditions. This is a capacity/service purchase commitment by the buyer, not a supplier claim. Not evidence of non-substitutability: Nebius's Q2 2026 shareholder letter (6-K 2026-08-12) describes the partnership as adding fuel-cell technology to the range of options available for future deployments.

sources.locator: Exhibit 99.2 附註 16 SUBSEQUENT EVENTS——Fuel Cell Capacity Agreement 段第 1 句（p.F-30 前）
sources.quote: On May 14, 2026, Nebius Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, entered into a Master Fuel Cell Capacity Agreement and related system orders (the “Capacity Agreement”) with Bloom Energy Corporation (the “Bloom”).

The power capacity being provided under the Capacity Agreement is expected to come on in three phases (each with a supply term of 10 years) and is expected to provide (in the aggregate) for guaranteed capacity of approximately 250MW and system installed capacity of approximately 328MW.

The Company will pay monthly services fees of up to $2.6 billion in the aggregate over the term of the Capacity Agreement, subject to commencement of the Capacity Agreement upon satisfaction of certain conditions.
